purpose: Test whether acquired observations can exclude the fixed0.65m depth prior before changing any model parameter or policy.
baseline: Frozen B6 outer_and_layers on full already acquired positive object tracks
method_api: profile_model(mapper, b6_ab_model) -> JSON-compatible diagnostic; pure/no mutation

profile_design.eligible: Exactly one acquired outside endpoint; retain current depth for no-anchor, two-anchor or degenerate domains.
profile_design.grid: 21 uniform depths from acquired span to max(1.3m,span), plus current depth explicitly.
profile_design.rays: All already acquired finite positive stride3 RGBD rays intersecting fixed maximum-search ROI containing all B6parts; exact duplicates removed; identical rays and denominator for all depths/hypotheses.
profile_design.geometry: Width/yaw/box-legheight/slabheights/backboard orientation and part thickness fixed to frozen B6AB; measured depth endpoint anchored.
profile_design.evidence: Mean clipped squared surface distances plus valid strict-free first-hit discrepancies using B2 cross-history surface veto; no penalty for occlusion or unknown/invalid data.
profile_design.mixture: Neutral0.5/0.5 box/shelf, scale.06m and clip.15m inherited; heuristic discrepancy, not a calibrated likelihood.
profile_design.plausible_band: J<=minJ+1, not confidence interval. Prior retained if in band, no free-conflict reduction, multimodal, or band reaches artificial upper search bound. Otherwise closest plausible grid point to prior is reported, not applied.
profile_design.proposal_adoption_condition: Prior excluded from a connected finite plausible band, and lower measured free contradiction in at least one hypothesis. This diagnostic reports the proposal without updating any model.

actor_input: Reconstruct original frozen B S prefixes only, assert packet/feedback/scores and native TSDF hash; current B6 AB G/S model arrays equal prior outputs. Profile receives neutral G model and actual acquired mapper.
unchanged: G/S object support and geometry, current template parameters and all arrays
candidate construction, score weights, action budget, return/stops
B5 O eight-run matrix, all B3/B4/B5/B6 frozen evidence
No robot motion, new branch acquisition, candidate scoring or model promotion in this phase

execution.candidate_evaluation_conditional: Only if the profile supports a separately specified parameter update; then all6prefixes and66branches must be evaluated with a new frozen model before any closed loop.

outputs: Per-object depth candidate curves, anchors, fixed ray hashes and admissible bands from the method
Full acquired input hashes and exact baseline model-array parity
All attempts and failures; no discarded states
interpretation: Observed depth compatibility is not reconstruction accuracy or semantic efficiency. Same six development prefixes remain dependent, not new scenes. Baseline array parity reflects the unchanged diagnostic phase, not a claim about a future parameter update.
